temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in some kind of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes Christian anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed and expanded: Jonathan was indeed hiding something important, and he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been keeping an important secret and is in unspecified trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth about what Jonathan is hiding and what trouble he is in.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it, but he accepts Christian's offer of support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been keeping an important secret and is in unspecified trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Updated: Jonathan is in serious/complicated trouble and needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs Christian's help and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help and support Jonathan, facing the trouble together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure, but he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, though he says he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious trouble and Christian suspects it may be related to criminal activity or dangerous people.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Partially confirmed/updated: Jonathan may be entangled with dangerous or criminal-associated people, but he denies illegal actions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with the wrong people, but the full truth is still unclear and Jonathan may not be a wrongdoer himself.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and to ensure Jonathan's safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; Christian tells Jonathan he believes someone is setting him up and that he has leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with dangerous or criminal-associated people, but the full truth is still unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Reversed/updated: Jonathan is not the culprit but is being framed by someone else.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed and is innocent; someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan; he tells Jonathan and plans to confront the culprit.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed, and Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Updated: the real culprit is a trusted mutual acquaintance close to both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both of them is responsible for framing Jonathan and has betrayed their trust.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
